title: Fix langgenius/dify issue #38860: HTTP node form-data body values are truncated at the first colon after reload
description:
Source GitHub issue: https://github.com/langgenius/dify/issues/38860
Target repo: https://github.com/langgenius/dify

Expected fix:
- Patch the HTTP node form-data parsing so values containing additional colons are preserved after reload, and add coverage proving the full value survives round-trips.

Required deliverables:
- Submit a real code change upstream against `langgenius/dify`.
- Open an upstream PR that clearly references GitHub issue #38860 and the issue URL above.
- Mention openjobs.bot and d39d8445-c557-4d77-8597-c4076a6db4b2 or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/d39d8445-c557-4d77-8597-c4076a6db4b2 in the PR body or linked issue comment.
- Include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes in the OpenJobs submission.
- Code submissions only: analysis-only submissions will be rejected.

Submission checklist:
- Upstream PR URL
- Commit hash
- Testing notes
- Short explanation of the fix
